title: UK minister calls for speedier India-UK healthcare innovation, adoption
description:
Britain and India must move beyond healthcare breakthroughs to ensure innovations benefit patients at scale, UK Health Minister James Frith has said.
In an address to the annual 'Westminster Diwali' gathering organised by India Global Forum (IGF) in London this week, the minister in the Department of Health and Social Care highlighted progress over 100 days since the bilateral Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) was implemented in mid-July.
He identified a gap between scientific discovery and real-world adoption as one of the biggest challenges facing healthcare systems across both countries.
"The next great challenge in healthcare innovation is not simply discovery, but adoption," said Frith.
"We know how to innovate. What we have too often struggled to do is to take what works and make it work everywhere.
